newsitem.title: USA: Alpha Industries names Paul Vincent CFO.
newsitem.headline: Alpha Industries names Paul Vincent CFO.

text.p: Alpha Industries Inc said on Wednesday Paul Vincent was named corporate vice president and chief financial officer.
Vincent was previously the company's corporate controller, the company said.
David Aldrich was previously chief financial officer, but he was named to head Alpha's semiconductor operations in spring 1996, an Alpha spokesman said.
Also, Alpha Industries said in a separate statement announced it appointed Richard Langman as president of Trans-Tech Inc, Alpha's technical ceramics subsidiary.
Joseph Alberici, who had resigned in spring 1996, had previously held the job, the Alpha spokesman said.
